title: oxytropis lanata
intro: Oxytropis lanata, commonly known as "woolly locoweed," is a perennial plant species in the family Fabaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Oxytropis lanata include its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit potential antiviral properties, although further research is necessary to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as glycosides, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
